sections.heading: C - Driving Safety
sections.markdown:
## C - Driving Safety

FACT_ID: sec07-F01 | anchor: A01
Pre-drive checks cover firm brakes, lit lamps, sound tires, and clean glass, with tinted rear glass demanding dual mirrors reaching 200 feet, then park, seat, mirrors, clear view, locks, and belts [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-F02 | anchor: A01
Backing starts with a walk-around for children, turns with an arm over the seat through the rear glass without trusting mirrors or cameras, rolls slowly, and uses a spotter when possible [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-F03 | anchor: A02
Blind corners hide beside both rear flanks, need head turns before lane moves and passes, forbid riding inside others, and grow with vehicle size [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec07-F04 | anchor: A02
Alert perception runs three-quarters to one second and reaction matches it, costing 55 feet at 50 MPH before braking starts [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec07-F05 | anchor: A02
Braking alone spans 158 feet at 50 MPH on dry grip, multiplies four, nine, and sixteen times with doubled, tripled, and quadrupled speed, and totals 268 feet with perception and reaction [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec07-F06 | anchor: A03
Following holds four seconds minimum by marker counting, and stretches in rain, dim light, passes, loads, and uphill queues [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec07-F07 | anchor: A04
Gaps widen for fall-prone bikes, crossing-bound buses, hazmat haulers, and blind-backed rigs, fire trucks keep 500 feet, and tailgated drivers slow rightward [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-F08 | anchor: A04
Trucks and tows space 300 feet outside cities and passes, and intersections halt at lines, yield after stops, scan both ways with a right glance, clear by arrival with right-side ties, and turn behind straight traffic [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-F09 | anchor: A04
Driveways yield to roads, walks, and bike lanes, and open crossings yield to occupants, state highways, paved roads, and oncoming left-turn conflicts [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-F10 | anchor: A05
Roundabouts circle one-way counterclockwise, yield entries to insiders and walkers, skip empty yields, forbid lane swaps and stops, signal exits, split straight-or-right right and straight-or-left-and-U left, and share with bikes [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec07-F11 | anchor: A05
Limited roads bar stops, lights, crossings, walkers, hitchhikers, bikes, carts, and small scooters, and entries check ramps, signal, accelerate, adjust, merge with yields, and never stop [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec07-F12 | anchor: A06
Exits take the right lane with signals and ramp speeds, never last-minute, and cruisers plan mile-matched exits, keep right, shun medians and stops, and clear breakdowns within six hours [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec07-F13 | anchor: A07
Highway drivers space out, never back ramps except past wrong-way signs and red reflectors, and rest when drowsy [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec07-F14 | anchor: A07
Move Over shields lit workers and rigs plus flagged disabled cars, vacating lanes or slowing 20 under on wide roads, slowing 20 under on two-lanes, and crawling 5 where limits read 20 or less [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec07-F15 | anchor: A07
Parking hugs roadside shoulders on the right except one-ways, parallels traffic with right wheels inside 12 inches, brakes with Park or Reverse, kills and locks with keys pocketed, and exits and reenters with checks, signals, and yields [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec07-F16 | anchor: A07
Hill parking rolls wheels from traffic into curbs, brakes, gears Park or Reverse downhill and First uphill, and kills the engine [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec07-F17 | anchor: A08
Straight-in cars center clear of lanes, and parking bans cover walks, lanes, crossings, spans, tunnels, driveways, yellow curbs, signed zones, doubles, bare pavement, and hazards, with 15 feet for hydrants, 20 for corners and stations, 30 for boxes and signs, and 50 for rails [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec07-F18 | anchor: A08
Hill wheels aim to curbs downhill, away uphill with curbs, and rightward uphill without [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec07-F19 | anchor: A09
Passing signals, hangs back, checks and rooms out, horns by day and flashes by night, returns past visible tires with signals, clears before 200 feet of oncoming, takes one car, and never speeds [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec07-F20 | anchor: A09
Passing bans cover solid lines and zones, hills and curves under 500 feet of sight, 100 feet of crossings and spans, halted buses, and walker queues [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec07-F21 | anchor: A09
Passed drivers hold speed, slide right, and cede the left lane to faster comers, while right-side passing needs two same-way lanes or a left-turning leader [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec07-F22 | anchor: A10
Yield law assigns priority, yet every road user must still do everything to dodge crashes [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec07-F23 | anchor: A10
Limits mark favorable-condition maximums demanding weather cuts, impact quadruples and nonuples with doubled and tripled speed, and no 10-over buffer exists [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec07-F24 | anchor: A10
Standard limits read 20 for schools, 30 for towns, 55 for roads, and 70 for limited ways, while laggards must flow right with 50 minimum under 70 postings [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec07-F25 | anchor: A10
Smooth stops scan rearward, coast off gas, and brake steadily alight, and two-lane drivers keep right except to pass [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec07-F26 | anchor: A11
Four-plus-lane roads stack right except to pass, and three- and five-lane centers turn left only [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec07-F27 | anchor: A11
HOV lanes serve doubled riders and decaled clean cars under diamond signs and buffers with gated entries [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec07-F28 | anchor: A11
Red lane-line reflectors flag wrong-way travel needing instant correction, and red edge reflectors flag wrong ramps needing pullovers [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec07-F29 | anchor: A11
Turns signal 100 feet ahead including lane changes, never invite passes, hand-signal leftward, slow, lane up, and honor no-turn plates [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec07-F30 | anchor: A12
Turners yield bikes, walkers, and oncoming streams, hold proper lanes, finish rights in right lanes and lefts in any lawful lane, and skip last-minute cuts for the next corner [A12].
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec07-F31 | anchor: A12
Three-point turns suit narrow dead-ends only, run right-signal-sharp-left-stop then reverse-sharp-right then forward, and never touch curves, hills, highways, or U-ban spots [A12].
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0078]
